text:
[Act: income-tax-2025
 Chapter: Penalties
 Section: 449::Penalty for failure to collect tax at source.
]


If any person fails to collect the whole or any part of the tax as required under Chapter XIX-B, the Assessing Officer may impose on him, a penalty equal to the tax which such person failed to collect.

metadata.section_title: Penalty for failure to collect tax at source.
